newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary June CPI jump was seasonal - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Hungary June CPI jump was seasonal - central bank.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary said on Friday that a rise in June inflation to 18.7 percent year-on-year was due to unpredictable, one-off seasonal factors.
The NBH earlier forecast a 17.4- 17.8 CPI for June.
"The June price index was not a reflection of an overall inflationary pressure," the NBH said in a statement, adding that the rise was due to the seasonality of fruit and vegetable prices.
"The rise of one product can suddenly change as a result of one-off factors which cannot be predicted," it said.

The Central Statistical Office (KSH) published June CPI figures earlier on Friday and detailed figures showed that while the overall month-on-month increase was 1.7 percent, food prices, which have a weight of 28.6 percent in the index, rose 4.0 percent.
The KSH added that the rise was due to the seasonality of fruit and vegetable prices.
The NBH said one single factor, a 150 percent rise of potato prices accounted for 0.9 percent of the monthly 1.7 percent rise in June.
"Without it, the CPI increase would have been 0.8 percent," the NBH said.
